subject: general
question: The ratio of the income to the expenditure of a town is 7 : 6. If the income is ₹3500, what is the saving?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Income : Expenditure = 7 : 6

Saving unit = Income unit − Expenditure unit = 7 − 6 = 1 unit

Given: 7 units (Income) = ₹3500

⇒ 1 unit (Saving) = 3500 ÷ 7 = ₹500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income : Expenditure = 7 : 6

Total Income = ₹3500

**Formula Used:**

Saving = Income − Expenditure

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cca16618a394ada258074fa4243ee100070d8d53081e36fb74ac02e76c46637.png] 

⇒ Let Income = 7x and Expenditure = 6x

⇒ 7x = 3500

⇒ x = 3500 ÷ 7

⇒ x = 500

⇒ Saving = Income − Expenditure

⇒ Saving = 7x − 6x = 1x

⇒ Saving = 1 × 500 = ₹500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relationship

Income is the sum of Expenditure and Savings (Income = Expenditure + Savings).

Saving Percentage

It is the ratio of saving to total income expressed as a percentage: (Saving ÷ Income) × 100.

Ratio Multiplier

If A : B is the ratio and the value of A is given, the multiplier is Value of A ÷ Ratio unit of A.
